comments.author: Sipto
comments.body_html:
Thanks for the kind words! I’ve updated the mod :)

Good instinct — it was a load-order bug, just against SPT itself rather than another mod. Wedge registered his items after SPT’s boot-time profile check, so any of his gear you kept looked like an unknown item once per restart. 2.0.2 registers them before the check runs — update and the error stops.

The helmet and NVGs are gone for good, I’m afraid: the “fix missing items” setting deletes them from the profile, and attachments go with their parent — that’s why the goggles vanished with the helmet. Set it back to false and take a fresh set off him. Thanks for the clear report — the “only when worn” detail and the config observation both helped.

comments.author: Sipto
comments.body_html: Fixed in 2.0.2. The mod was registering his items after SPT’s boot-time profile check, so kept gear tripped the profile error on every restart. Update and your profile loads with the items intact — no more clearing anything.

comments.author: Sipto
comments.body_html: That error is harmless. Content Backport 1.1.1 started shipping the M8230’s asset bundles itself (older versions declared them but didn’t include the files, so Wedge has been carrying them). When two mods provide the same bundle, the server keeps the first copy and prints that red line for the second one - the grenade still loads fine either way. If the M8230 shows up in raid and the gas works, nothing is broken. The next Wedge update will drop the duplicated bundles now that Content Backport ships its own, which gets rid of those two lines.
